statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was billed under CPT 93229
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The submitted clinical indication note documents the ordering rationale
The dizziness and giddiness are concerning for potential arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
